LESSON: HADITH ON:

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HADITH
Topic 4.1: Hadith on:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Hadith on:. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how obedience etc)?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Recite the selected Hadith to show obedience to parents
2. Practice obedience in their day to day life to follow the orders of Allah
3. Appreciate the importance of the Hadith in shaping the life of an individual.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Recite the selected Hadith to show obedience to parents
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recite the selected Hadith to show obedience to parents. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Practice obedience in their day to day life to follow the orders of Allah
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to practice obedience in their day to day life to follow the orders of Allah. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate the importance of the Hadith in shaping the life of an individual.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of the Hadith in shaping the life of an individual. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Hadith on:.
2. Explain Hadith on: to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on:.
4. Show that you can: Recite the selected Hadith to show obedience to parents
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on:. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how obedience etc)?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Recite the selected Hadith to show obedience to parents
2. Practice obedience in their day to day life to follow the orders of Allah
3. Appreciate the importance of the Hadith in shaping the life of an individual.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
